# VibeScript Solutions

> VibeScript Solutions is a Mumbai-based AI automation agency and web app development company, founded by Shams Ali Shaikh.

## Services
- AI automation: lead handling, customer support, reports, document processing
- Social media marketing automation: AI writes captions, creates posts and publishes on schedule
- Web app, mobile app and SaaS development
- Performance optimization
